agitated.en: I keep looking for my missing toy.
agitated.zh: 我一直找不到最喜欢的玩具。

agitated.en: Can you help me look for it?

alarmed.zh: 刚才我一下子被吓到了！

alarmed.en: I jumped when I heard the noise.
alarmed.zh: 听见那声响，我吓得跳起来。

aloof.en: I do not feel like joining in.
aloof.zh: 我现在不太想加入大家。

aloof.en: I would rather watch the game for now.
aloof.zh: 我现在更想先看看他们玩。

aloof.en: Can I join later if I feel ready?
aloof.zh: 等我想加入的时候再参加好吗？

apathetic.en: I do not feel interested right now.
apathetic.zh: 我现在对什么都提不起兴趣。

apathetic.en: Even my usual games feel dull today.
apathetic.zh: 连平时爱玩的游戏今天也没意思。

apprehensive.en: I feel a little uneasy about tomorrow.
I keep thinking about the big test.
apprehensive.zh: 我一直想着那场重要的考试。

beat.zh: 我们在外面玩了一下午。

beat.en: Can we sit down for a while?
beat.zh: 我们能坐下来休息会儿吗？

bewildered.en: I cannot follow the rules of this game.
bewildered.zh: 这个游戏的规则我没弄懂。

bewildered.en: Could you show me how to play?
bewildered.zh: 你能示范一下怎么玩吗？

bitter.en: I still feel upset about what happened.
bitter.zh: 那件事让我一直心里不舒服。

bitter.en: It felt unfair when I did not get a turn.
bitter.zh: 没轮到我，我觉得很不公平。

bitter.en: Could we talk about what happened?
bitter.zh: 我们能聊聊刚才的事吗？

blue.en: I feel a little blue today.
The rain makes me miss playing with friends.
blue.zh: 下雨了，我好想和朋友出去玩。

blue.en: Could we play something together indoors?
blue.zh: 我们能在屋里一起玩点什么吗？

brokenhearted.en: I miss my best friend so much.
Can I talk about how much I miss them?
brokenhearted.zh: 我能跟你说说我有多想他们吗？

chagrined.en: I planned carefully, but it went wrong.
chagrined.zh: 我认真计划了，可结果出了差错。

chagrined.en: May I try a different way?

cold.en: I feel distant from everyone today.
cold.zh: 今天我不太想和别人亲近。
我刚才回答得有点冷淡。

cold.en: Can I have some space for a while?
cold.zh: 我能一个人待一会儿吗？

concerned-unmet.en: I am worried about my friend.
They are not feeling well today.
Can we check how they are doing?
concerned-unmet.zh: 我们能问问他们好些了吗？

cross.zh: 有人一直打断我玩游戏。

dejected.en: Losing the game left me disappointed.
Can we try again another day?

depressed.en: I have been feeling very low.
depressed.zh: 我最近情绪一直很低落。

depressed.en: Things I usually enjoy do not feel fun.
depressed.zh: 平时喜欢的事情也提不起兴趣。

depressed.en: Could I talk with someone I trust?
depressed.zh: 我能找信任的人谈谈吗？

despairing.en: It feels as if nothing will work.
despairing.zh: 我现在觉得怎么做都没用。

despairing.en: I have tried so many times.
Can someone help me find a new way?
despairing.zh: 有人能帮我想个新办法吗？

despondent.en: I feel sad and out of energy.
despondent.zh: 我很难过，也没什么力气。

despondent.en: I do not feel ready to play right now.
Could you sit with me for a bit?

detached.en: I feel far away from everyone.
detached.zh: 我觉得自己和大家有些疏远。

detached.en: I am here, but I do not feel connected.
detached.zh: 虽然我在这里，却觉得融不进去。

detached.en: Could we spend some time talking?
detached.zh: 我们能一起聊一会儿吗？

disaffected.en: I do not enjoy this like I used to.
disaffected.zh: 这件事不像以前那样让我开心。

disaffected.en: I used to love this hobby, but not today.
disaffected.zh: 我以前很喜欢这个爱好，今天却提不起兴趣。
我们能试试别的事情吗？

disenchanted.en: It is not as magical as I imagined.
disenchanted.zh: 它不像我想象中那么美好了。

disenchanted.en: I learned something that changed my opinion.
disenchanted.zh: 我知道了一件事，想法也变了。

disenchanted.en: Can we talk about why I feel disappointed?
disenchanted.zh: 我们能聊聊我为什么失望吗？

disgruntled.en: I am not happy about this.
The plan changed without telling me.
disgruntled.zh: 计划变了，却没人告诉我。

disgruntled.en: Could we talk about the change?
disgruntled.zh: 我们能聊聊这个变化吗？

disgusted.zh: 坏掉的食物闻起来很难闻。

disgusted.en: Can we move away from it?

disheartened.en: I keep trying, but I have not succeeded yet.
disheartened.zh: 我一直在试，可还没有成功。

disheartened.en: Can you help me think of a new idea?
disheartened.zh: 你能帮我想个新办法吗？

dismayed.en: Oh no, that plan fell apart!

dismayed.zh: 我们能重新想个办法吗？

displeased.en: I am not pleased with this.
I thought the movie would be more fun.
displeased.zh: 我以为这部电影会更好看。

displeased.en: Could we choose something else next time?

disquieted.en: I heard a strange noise at night.
disquieted.zh: 晚上我听见了奇怪的声音。

disquieted.en: Can you check it with me?

distressed.en: I feel very upset right now.

distressed.zh: 今天发生了一件让我难过的事。

distressed.en: Can I tell you about it?

disturbed.en: I was concentrating on my game.
disturbed.zh: 我刚才正专心玩游戏呢。

disturbed.en: Could you give me a moment to finish?
disturbed.zh: 你能等我做完这一点吗？

downcast.en: The day did not go as I hoped.
downcast.zh: 今天没有像我想的那么顺利。

downcast.en: Could we do something gentle together?
downcast.zh: 我们能一起做点轻松的事吗？

downhearted.en: The bad news made me sad.
downhearted.zh: 那个不好的消息让我难过。

downhearted.en: Can you listen to me for a while?

dull.en: Today has been the same thing over and over.
dull.zh: 今天一直在重复做同样的事。

dull.en: Could we try a new game?

edgy.en: I am waiting for my turn to perform.
Can I take a deep breath first?

embittered.en: I still feel hurt and angry.
Being blamed unfairly really upset me.
Can we talk about what is fair?
embittered.zh: 我们能聊聊什么才公平吗？

exasperated.en: I have tried again and again.
exasperated.zh: 我已经反复试了好多次。

exasperated.en: Can you help me take a short break?

exhausted.en: Today was full of running and playing.
Can I rest before we go on?
exhausted.zh: 我们继续前，我能先休息吗？

fatigued.en: That long walk used up my energy.
fatigued.zh: 刚才走了很远，我没力气了。

fidgety.en: My legs keep wanting to move.
Can I stand up for a minute?
fidgety.zh: 我能站起来活动一会儿吗？

forlorn.en: I have no one to play with right now.

furious.en: Someone ruined something I worked hard on.
furious.zh: 有人弄坏了我辛苦做的东西。

furious.en: I need space before I talk.
furious.zh: 我想先静静，等会儿再说。

gloomy.en: The rain and quiet house make me sad.
gloomy.zh: 下雨又安静的家里让我有点难过。

gloomy.en: Could you stay and read with me?

guilty.en: I feel guilty about what I did.
guilty.zh: 我为自己做的事感到内疚。

guilty.en: I wish I had not lied to you.
guilty.zh: 我真希望自己没有对你说谎。

guilty.en: Can I tell the truth now?
guilty.zh: 我现在能把实话告诉你吗？

harried.en: I have too many things to do at once.
harried.zh: 我一下子要做太多事了。

harried.en: Can we make a list and do one thing first?
harried.zh: 我们能列个清单，一件件来吗？

heavy.en: I am carrying a lot of sadness today.
heavy.zh: 今天我心里有好多难过。

heavy.en: Could you listen without rushing me?

helpless.en: I do not know how to make this better.
helpless.zh: 我不知道怎么让事情好起来。

helpless.en: Could you help me find someone who can?
helpless.zh: 你能帮我找个能帮忙的人吗？

hesitant.en: I am not ready to try yet.
That new activity feels a little scary.
hesitant.zh: 那个新活动让我有点害怕。

hesitant.en: Can we start with a small step?
hesitant.zh: 我们能先从简单的一步开始吗？

horrible.en: I had a really bad dream.
horrible.zh: 我做了一个很可怕的梦。

horrible.en: Could you stay until I feel calm?
horrible.zh: 你能陪我到平静下来吗？

horrified.zh: 我看到了很吓人的东西。

horrified.en: Can we leave this place now?
horrified.zh: 我们现在能离开这里吗？

hostile.en: I feel angry and unfriendly right now.
hostile.zh: 我现在生气得不想理人。

hostile.en: I am too upset to talk politely.
hostile.zh: 我太生气了，没法好好说话。

hostile.en: Can I calm down before we talk?
hostile.zh: 等我冷静下来再说好吗？

hot.en: The sun is making me sweat.
Can we find some shade and water?
hot.zh: 我们能找个阴凉处喝点水吗？

humdrum.en: This day feels the same as yesterday.
I am bored of doing the same thing.
humdrum.zh: 老做同一件事，我有点烦了。

humdrum.en: Can we try a different activity?

indifferent.en: I do not really mind either way.
Both games seem fine to me.
indifferent.zh: 这两个游戏我觉得都可以。

intense-unmet.en: My feelings are really strong right now.
I am worried about something important.
intense-unmet.zh: 我对一件重要的事很担心。

intense-unmet.en: Can we slow down and talk?
